propositions: Each xdist worker maintains a separate process-local LRU cache of rendered wiki corpus bodies, causing 178 corpus bodies to be re-rendered by pandoc three times instead of once when running with -n 3 --dist worksteal, burning ~56s of wasted CPU
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 markdown renders that are already cached in _rendered(), duplicating ~12s of work per test

Replace process-local lru_cache with a session-scoped digest-keyed artifact on shared disk, sharded per stratum with worker-rotated probe order to eliminate redundant renders while keeping wall time sublinear
Implement inter-process mutual exclusion using atomic os.mkdir with 150s deadline fallback so a loser worker renders locally rather than deadlocking if a winner crashes

Verify that all 178 corpus bodies still render against real pandoc through unchanged assertions, and that under -n 3 --dist worksteal the largest test drops from 40-45s to under 20s while staying below the 300s timeout guard
